text:
Mika: tiny cactus holiday swap! 🎄🌵 idea: we each sign up to send a small, desk-friendly succulent + a tiny note. atmospheric pics encouraged. who's in? @here
Raj: in! can i request low-light plants? my apartment gets zero sun :(
Zoe: count me in. i can ship from EU — anyone have customs tips?
ops-bot: reminder: keep plant gifts under $15 and avoid loose soil in packages per office mail policy. see #logistics for details.
Jon: love it. can we do a quick poll for pet-friendly vs not? my cat eats everything.
Mika: good call. poll options: 1) pet-friendly 2) low-maintenance 3) no-soil (cuttings). reply with the number(s) you prefer
Raj: 2
Zoe: 1 2
Priya: 3 — i'll volunteer to include extra packing tape & silica gel packets :D
Ethan: also +1 for photos — maybe a 5-min ‘tiny plant tour’ during the holiday all-hands?
Mika: :thumbsup: sweet. i'll make a sign-up sheet and DM addresses. deadline Fri 12/8.
Zoe: oh oh can we add tiny decorations? like a 1-inch pompom or a sticker on the pot
Raj: yes please, tiny pompom winner
Mika: ok final note: remember export/import rules if you're sending abroad — double-check country regs. i’ll post the signup link in #random when it’s ready
Priya: :tada: thanks! super excited to adopt a desk cactus :)
